title: Store health event
description: streams.store.health_changed: a streaming store's health as a manager sees it (closed by hours wins, then live, off air or problem). Published by fck-web-stream's store health watcher, consumed by rad-api-notifications. Added in contract 2.2.0; versioned on its own `schema_version`.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR of this event's own schema. A reader accepts any minor of a major it reads.

event_id.description: Unique per message; consumers dedupe on it.

timestamp.description: Publish time. Not when the state began (`payload.since`).

state.description: live: audio is going out. off_air: open by store hours, but no player holds the store (stream idle). problem: open and the stream is degraded or down. closed: outside store hours, whatever the stream does.

previous_state.description: The state `state` replaced at `since`; never equal to `state`. Null when nothing is known before it (the watcher's first sight of the store).

occurred_at.description: When the watcher decided this event. Equal to `since` for the change itself; later for an alert that waited for a state to hold.

alert.description: True when a manager should be notified of this event. The watcher applies every timing rule, so a consumer notifies on true and does nothing on false.
